summary: Master SEO and Generative Engine Optimization to improve AI search visibility, citations, and reporting. Build practical GEO workflows in 5 days.
lede: GEO training helps SEO, content, analytics, and digital growth practitioners adapt content and measurement for traditional and AI-led search. It covers the practical work of assessing visibility and structuring pages for discovery, including keyword and prompt research, entity-rich content planning, and schema review. Participants also learn to monitor AI referrals and build reporting workflows that connect search visibility with business outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for practitioners who already work in SEO, content, analytics, or digital growth and now need to adapt to AI-led search. You will find it most useful if you manage pages, content briefs, reporting dashboards, or technical SEO priorities and need a practical framework for GEO execution.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work with live or sample website data. Access to Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 is useful for the exercises, while spreadsheet software and a content editor are recommended for the workshop outputs.
